sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?metricLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_EVALUATION ?evaluation .
  ?evaluation orkgp:P110006 ?metric .
  ?metric rdfs:label ?metricLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?guidelineLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181031 ?annotationProcess .
  ?annotationProcess orkgp:P181036 ?annotationScheme .
  ?annotationScheme orkgp:P181038 ?guideline .
  ?guideline rdfs:label ?guidelineLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?guidelineLabel)), "yes"))
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?inputLabel ?reTaskLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181002 ?reTask .
  ?reTask rdfs:label ?reTaskLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181003 ?nlpTask .
  ?nlpTask orkgp:P181005 ?input .
  ?input rdfs:label ?inputLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?inputLabel ?reTaskLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?baselineLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_EVALUATION ?evaluation .
  ?evaluation orkgp:P181051 ?baselineComparison .
  ?baselineComparison orkgp:P181052 ?baseline .
  ?baseline rdfs:label ?baselineLabel .

ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?formatLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181011 ?dataset .
  ?dataset orkgp:P181022 ?dataType .
  ?dataType orkgp:P181023 ?format .
  ?format rdfs:label ?formatLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?reliabilityMetricLabel ?measuredAgreementLabel ?conflictResolutionLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181031 ?annotationProcess .
  ?annotationProcess orkgp:P181041 ?annotatorAgreement .
  OPTIONAL { ?annotatorAgreement orkgp:P181042 ?reliabilityMetric . ?reliabilityMetric rdfs:label ?reliabilityMetricLabel . }
  OPTIONAL { ?annotatorAgreement orkgp:P181045 ?measuredAgreement . ?measuredAgreement rdfs:label ?measuredAgreementLabel . }
  OPTIONAL { ?annotatorAgreement orkgp:P181044 ?conflictResolution . ?conflictResolution rdfs:label ?conflictResolutionLabel . }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?reTaskLabel ?nlpTaskTypeLabel ?dataset ?datasetUrl WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181002 ?reTask .
  ?reTask rdfs:label ?reTaskLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181003 ?nlpTask .
  ?nlpTask orkgp:P181004 ?nlpTaskType .
  ?nlpTaskType rdfs:label ?nlpTaskTypeLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181011 ?dataset .
  OPTIONAL { ?dataset orkgp:P181028 ?location . ?location orkgp:P1003 ?datasetUrl . }
}
ORDER BY ?reTaskLabel ?nlpTaskTypeLabel ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?nlpTaskTypeLabel ?numAnnotators WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181003 ?nlpTask .
  ?nlpTask orkgp:P181004 ?nlpTaskType .
  ?nlpTaskType rdfs:label ?nlpTaskTypeLabel .

  ?annotationProcess orkgp:P181032 ?annotator .

}

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?constructLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C115015 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P175094 ?construct .
  ?construct rdfs:label ?constructLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?constructLabel ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?constructLabel ?measuredByLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C115015 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P175094 ?construct .
  ?construct rdfs:label ?constructLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?constructLabel)) = LCASE("impulsivity"))
  OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P175095 ?measuredBy . ?measuredBy rdfs:label ?measuredByLabel . }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?construct) AS ?constructCount) WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C115015 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P175094 ?construct .
}
GROUP BY ?paper ?paperLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?constructCount) ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?approachLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?approach .
  ?approach rdfs:label ?approachLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?approachLabel ?paperLabel
